title: Furax
extract:
The Furax are fist weapons focused on critical stats, primarily used by Grineer Powerfists.
This weapon can be sold for  5,000. It is also a weapon crafting ingredient for  Knux.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Seismic Palm and  Gaia's Tragedy stances.
Can use the Furax-exclusive  Amalgam Furax Body Count mod.

Acquisition
The Furax's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Notes

Incarnon Genesis

Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn  Furax Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Furax with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for  120, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

Installing the Furax Incarnon Genesis requires 20  Pathos Clamps, 70  Dracroot, and 300  Ariette Scales.
When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 affinity to the weapon, affected by Affinity Boosters.

Overview
Incarnon Form is charged by building Melee Combo to 6x, then using a Heavy Attack. Once activated, the Incarnon form lasts for 180 seconds.
Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, Incarnon Form is removed upon death.

Evolutions

Tips
The execution blow has a small AOE which only affects the units slightly overlapping the executed unit.
The ground slam attack knocks enemies down in a small area.

Trivia
Furax (fūrax) in Latin means "thieving."
Furax is used in many Latin names for living things.
